lines.zh: 一块岩石里，明明有很多孔隙。水从左边进入，为什么还是到不了右边？
lines.en: A rock contains many pores. Why can water enter on the left, yet fail to reach the right?

lines.zh: 把镜头拉近，你会发现：有些孔只连着身边的几个孔，前面却是一堵墙。
lines.en: Look closer: some pores connect to nearby pores, but then meet a wall.

lines.zh: 孔隙的数量很重要，但能不能连成一条通路，同样重要。
lines.en: The number of pores matters. So does whether they form a connected route.

lines.zh: 今天，我们用一个可以重复的随机实验，看清渗流的临界点。
lines.en: A reproducible random experiment will help us understand the percolation threshold.

lines.zh: 先把复杂的岩石，简化成一张方格纸。蓝色格子表示开放，深色格子表示阻塞。
lines.en: Simplify the rock into a grid: blue sites are open; dark sites are blocked.

lines.zh: 每个格子独立地，以概率 p 开放。这里的 p，是模型参数，不是某一次的精确开放比例。
lines.en: Each site opens independently with probability p. It is a model parameter, not the exact open fraction in one trial.

lines.zh: 开放的格子，只有上下左右共享一条边，才算连接。对角碰到，不算连接。
lines.en: Open sites connect only through shared edges: up, down, left or right. Diagonal contact does not count.

lines.zh: 我们从左边界出发，沿开放格子探索。能到右边界，就叫贯穿。
lines.en: Explore open sites from the left boundary. Reaching the right boundary means a crossing.

lines.zh: 这只是连通模型。画面里的水，表示能够到达，不表示真实流速。
lines.en: This is a connectivity model. The water shows reachability, not physical flow speed.

lines.zh: 当开放概率较低，亮起来的格子，大多组成零散的小岛。
lines.en: At low opening probability, most open sites form small, scattered islands.

lines.zh: 每一团彼此连接的开放格子，叫作一个连通簇。
lines.en: Each connected group of open sites is called a cluster.

lines.zh: 随着开放概率增加，新的格子会把原来的小簇连接起来。
lines.en: As opening probability increases, new sites can join existing clusters.

lines.zh: 但是，簇变大了，并不一定已经贯穿。注意金色区域：只有它能从入口到达。
lines.en: A larger cluster need not span the grid. Only the gold region is reachable from the inlet.

lines.zh: 蓝色区域虽然开放，却可能仍然与入口隔离。
lines.en: Blue regions are open, but may remain disconnected from the inlet.

lines.zh: 现在，固定同一个随机样本，把开放概率从百分之五十八，逐渐提高到百分之六十。
lines.en: Keep the same random sample, and raise p from 58 percent to 60 percent.

lines.zh: 每个格子都有预先抽好的随机数，因此新画面只会增加开放格子。
lines.en: Each site has a preassigned random number, so increasing p only adds open sites.

lines.zh: 看这里：新增的格子接上了两边的簇，一条横跨网格的通路出现了。
lines.en: Watch: newly opened sites join clusters, creating a route across the grid.

lines.zh: 我们把这一刻放慢。变化发生在少数连接处，影响却覆盖了整个网格。
lines.en: Slow it down: a few local connections change connectivity across the whole grid.

lines.zh: 这是专门选来讲解的示例样本。它首次贯穿的数值，不等于理论临界值。
lines.en: This sample was selected for illustration. Its first-crossing value is not the theoretical threshold.

lines.zh: 换一张随机方格，同样的开放概率，可能得到不同结果。
lines.en: A different random grid can give a different result at the same p.

lines.zh: 所以，我们在一百二十八乘一百二十八的网格上，分别重复一千次独立试验。
lines.en: We run one thousand independent trials for each probability on a 128 by 128 grid.

lines.zh: 开放概率为百分之五十八时，有187次贯穿；百分之六十时，有700次贯穿。
lines.en: At p = 58%, 187 trials cross; at p = 60%, 700 trials cross.

lines.zh: 这些是本次模拟的结果。条形图旁的线段，表示百分之九十五置信区间。
lines.en: These are the results of this simulation. The whiskers show 95% confidence intervals.

lines.zh: 概率差异可以很明显，但有限网格里的失败，不等于数学上的绝对不可能。
lines.en: The difference can be substantial, but failure in a finite grid does not mean mathematical impossibility.

lines.zh: 横轴是开放概率，纵轴是重复试验得到的贯穿概率。每个点都由五百次试验计算。
lines.en: The horizontal axis is p; the vertical axis is crossing probability. Each point comes from 500 trials.

lines.zh: 比较三种网格尺寸：三十二、六十四，以及一百二十八。
lines.en: Compare three grid sizes: 32, 64 and 128 sites per side.

lines.zh: 网格越大，临界附近的过渡通常越陡。这叫有限尺寸效应。
lines.en: Larger grids usually show a sharper transition near criticality: a finite-size effect.

lines.zh: 对无限大的正方形格点、四邻接、独立点渗流，临界开放概率约为百分之五十九点二七。
lines.en: For independent site percolation on an infinite square lattice with four neighbors, the threshold is about 59.27%.

lines.zh: 这个数字属于特定模型。它不是所有材料和网络共用的常数。
lines.en: This number belongs to a specific model. It is not a universal constant for materials and networks.

lines.zh: 把孔隙换成导电颗粒，周围换成绝缘材料。连接问题，又出现了。
lines.en: Replace pores with conducting particles in an insulating material. Connectivity matters again.

lines.zh: 孤立的颗粒，不能构成横跨样品的导电通路。
lines.en: Isolated particles cannot form a conducting route across the sample.

lines.zh: 当颗粒的接触网络连通两端，电流就有了可以通过的路径。
lines.en: When the contact network connects both sides, a route becomes available for current.

lines.zh: 现实里，颗粒形状、接触方式和空间维度，都会改变阈值。这里展示的是简化示意。
lines.en: Particle shape, contact rules and spatial dimension affect the threshold. This is a simplified illustration.

lines.zh: 记住三个词：开放概率，连通簇，以及贯穿。
lines.en: Remember three ideas: opening probability, clusters and crossings.

lines.zh: 渗流理论研究的，是局部的随机连接，怎样形成系统尺度的通路。
lines.en: Percolation studies how local random connections create system-wide routes.

lines.zh: 临界附近，小小的增加，可能带来很大的连通变化。要判断规律，仍然需要重复试验。
lines.en: Near criticality, small increases can strongly change connectivity. Repeated trials are still needed.

lines.zh: 它可以启发我们理解连接，却不能证明，百分之五十八的努力，就等于没有努力。
lines.en: It can inspire thinking about connections, but cannot prove that 58% effort equals no effort.

lines.zh: 数量之外，看连接。一次结果之外，看概率。
lines.en: Beyond quantity, look at connectivity. Beyond one result, look at probability.
